description: Celestica is a Canadian EMS (Electronics Manufacturing Services) company that has rapidly become one of the leading contract manufacturers for AI infrastructure — assembling AI servers, networking switches, storage arrays, and hardware platform solutions for hyperscale data center operators. Its Connectivity and Cloud segment grew 76% year-over-year in Q1 2026. Q1 2026 revenue of $4.05 billion (+53% YoY) drove management to raise full-year 2026 guidance to $17 billion with $8.75 adjusted EPS. The company is expanding capacity in Thailand and building a major new Texas facility.
